answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 62697 Country: United States of America Title: Joining Jama'at after you've started namaz Question: If you have started praying your fardh namaz and some people start Jama'at behind you, do you break your namaz to join them or you continue on yourself? And also if you have prayed your fardh namaz and some brothers come and form jama'at for the same fardh namaz, is it better to join them? If yes, what niyyat should I do before joining? Answer ID: 62697 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 195/201/L=03/1437) If some people come in the mosque after the jamah of the mosque is over and they establish second jamah then you should not join them by breaking your salah rather complete your salah. Likewise if you have offered fardh salah alone then do not join them in jamah with nafl intention. However if you are offering fardh salah alone and the jamah of the mosque starts then you may join the jamah of the mosque by breaking your salah provided you have not completed one rakah of two rakah salah and three rakahs of the four rakah salah. Likewise if you have completed fardh salah alone then you may join the imam in Zuhr and Isha salah with nafl intention. So is mentioned in the books of Fiqh and Fatawa. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
